outlook.statement: The Indian economy is expected to grow around 6.5% in the upcoming year with the service sector remaining the primary contributor to the overall GDP growth. The outlook for the auto parts distribution industry remains moderately positive and resilient, with steady long-term growth expected despite short-term challenges. We expect to continue our growth due to our strong presence in smaller cities, towns, and rural areas. Increasing commodity prices may limit the volume growth.

risks: Rising fuel prices and inflationary trends may restrict volume growth for genuine parts. Increasing commodity prices may limit the volume growth.
